title: Cardiovascular Biorepository
summary: Use biospecimens procured from patients and organ donors to improve understanding of molecular, cellular, and tissue-level processes produced by cardiovascular disease and therapeutic interventions
criteria:
Inclusion Criteria:

* All patients undergoing cardiovascular surgery/procedure at the University of Kentucky who are at least 18 years of age, and organ donors of any age.

sites.f: University of Kentucky, Department of Internal Medicine, Division of Cardiovascular Medicine
